message: VACUUM FULL rewrites the whole table while blocking reads and writes. Inside a transaction, PostgreSQL rejects it: "VACUUM cannot run inside a transaction block".
why: VACUUM FULL and CLUSTER take an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and write a new copy of the table. REINDEX takes a SHARE lock on the table and an exclusive lock on each index it rebuilds. The lock is held until the command finishes, which on a large table can take minutes or hours.
safeAlternative: Do not run VACUUM FULL from a migration. Run it in a maintenance window, or use a tool that rebuilds tables online, such as pg_repack.
